content.title: Is Dunkin’ open on Easter Sunday? Store hours for April 20
content.text: BusinessDunkin' will be open on Easter Sunday, which is on April 20, 2025.Patti Sapone | NJ Advance Media Popular coffee and doughnut chain Dunkin’ is getting ready for all the Easter celebrations. The shop’s Spring MUNCHKINS Bucket big enough for a 50-count assortment of MUNCHKIN Donut Hole Treats is back for another year. Plus, they come with the new Blueberry Sprinkle MUNCHKINS to match with the bright Easter theme.You can tote these to your upcoming Easter celebrations and egg hunts or bring a dozen doughnuts with the new Cotton Candy Specialty Donut.However, it might not be clear that you’ll be able to pick up a bucket and your favorite coffee on Easter Sunday because it is a holiday and a few businesses do close for the day. Here’s everything you need to know about Dunkin’ on Easter, which falls on Sunday, April 20, this year. READ MORE: What grocery stores are open on Easter 2025? ShopRite hours, Whole Foods hours, Wegmans hoursIs Dunkin’ open on Easter 2025? Those hoping to pick up sweet treats and their go-to cup of coffee on Easter are in luck. Dunkin’ will be open this Sunday, April 20, during each location’s usual operating hours. However, these hours may vary, so you should check with your local Dunkin’ before stopping by. Typical Dunkin’ opening hours range between 4 a.m. to 7 a.m. (depending on location). While closing hours range between 7 p.m. to 9 p.m., but keep in mind, many Dunkin’ locations do close earlier than usual on holidays, if open.Dunkin’ is known for staying open on Easter so customers can purchase food for the holiday.You can find your nearest Dunkin’ location from the store’s website here.
